verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any public status-lookup page for a filing, application, or case, such as an EIN application status or e-file acceptance tracker. The items that come closest are a bare 'Business Tax Account' title and a 'Tax record (transcript)' link. Neither describes status lookup; both are adjacent account and record features, and online account access sits behind ID.me identity proofing rather than on public pages.
